follow-up time: Throughout pregnancy (until 24-28 weeks gestation for GDM diagnosis)
outcome: Homeostasis Model Assessment for Insulin Resistance (HOMA-IR) values
cohort: 358 women with GDM and 1324 women with NGT from a Chinese population.
finding: Increased first-trimester Hb levels were closely associated with the development of GDM and adverse pregnancy outcomes, with this association moderated by the Hp2-2 genotype.
